messages:
tara: Quick sync  we're preparing AWS/GCP/Azure marketplace listings (plus ACME hardware mention). Target: staging listings with a 30-day trial by next Wednesday. Need clear owners: infra/KMS, SKU + metering mapping, legal for EULA/announcement, marketing assets, and SI/partner runbook. Who can pick up?
ben: I can take infra/KMS and do a staging deploy to validate entitlement flows. I'll also add a minimal IAM example for AWS.
anika: I'll own SKU manifests and metering mapping (tokens -> units). Will propose seat vs token examples for marketplace and private-offer variants.
mike: I'll do the SI playbook and offline-image checklist for ACME HW customers. Also add escalation matrix.
sophie: I'll review EULA and announcement copy; need final product blurbs for legal to sign off.
raj: I'll collect hero images/screenshots and assemble the quickstart doc. Will tag design and engineering.
ben: AWS IAM example (minimal): `{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"Service":"marketplace.amazonaws.com"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]}`
anika: Draft manifest snippet: `sku_id: rwinf-acme-edge; metering: token_units; trial_days: 30; billing_models: [seats, token_units]`
marketplace-bot: Created checklist MP-11021 (crosscloud-acme) and assigned to team: https://internal.redwood/marketplace/MP-11021
tara: Plan: Mon morning final checks, Tue afternoon preflight, Wed staging publish. Action items: ben - infra snippet + staging deploy (Mon EOD); anika - SKU + pricing mapping (Mon noon); sophie - legal copy (Mon AM); mike - SI runbook (Tue EOD); raj - assets (Mon noon). Ping blockers in this thread. Thanks!
